# Bland AI

Bland AI is a conversational AI platform for building, operating, and evaluating voice agents, calls, messaging, and related communications workflows.

Category: Communication. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/bland-ai/.

## Actions

- **Create Pathway Folder**: Create an empty pathway folder, optionally nested under an existing folder, without running calls or agents.
- **Delete Pathway Folder**: Delete an empty pathway folder by ID.
- **Get Account Details** (read-only): Return the connected Bland AI account's status, call count, balance, and refill settings without changing the account.
- **List Calls** (read-only): Search the connected account's existing inbound and outbound call history without placing or modifying calls.
- **List Contacts** (read-only): Return organization contacts and their identifiers and memory records one page at a time.
- **List Knowledge Bases** (read-only): Return one page of the connected Bland AI organization's knowledge bases, including processing status, source details, and file metadata.
- **List Pathway Folders** (read-only): Return all pathway folders and their parent relationships from Bland's US regional pathway service.
- **List Pathways** (read-only): Return all conversational pathways, including their names, descriptions, nodes, and edges.
- **List Tools** (read-only): Search and page through the active or draft tools configured for Bland agents.
- **Rename Pathway Folder**: Rename an existing pathway folder without moving or changing any pathways inside it.
